name: Nainital
tagline: The City of Lakes & Sacred Kumaon Footprints
shortDesc: Renowned for pear-shaped Naini Lake, sacred Naina Devi Temple, Kainchi Dham of Neem Karoli Baba, colonial heritage, oak-pine ridges, and lake clusters.
bestSeason: March to June & September to December (Winter Snow: Jan–Feb)

name: Pithoragarh
tagline: Gateway to the High Himalayas, Adi Kailash & Panchachuli
shortDesc: The crown of eastern Uttarakhand bordering Tibet and Nepal. Home to the Panchachuli peaks, Munsiyari, sacred Adi Kailash, Om Parvat, Darma Valley, and Patal Bhuvaneshwar.
bestSeason: April to June & September to November

name: Almora
tagline: Cultural Capital of Kumaon & Ancient Sun Temples
shortDesc: Famed for its horseshoe-shaped ridge, vibrant Kumaoni arts, Kasar Devi's geomagnetic sanctuary, Jageshwar Dham's 124 stone temples, and Katarmal Sun Temple.

name: Bageshwar
shortDesc: Sacred confluence where Bagnath Temple stands. Starting point for the iconic Pindari, Kafni, and Sunderdhunga Himalayan glacier treks, and ancient Baijnath temples.
bestSeason: September to November & April to June

name: Champawat
tagline: Cradle of Chand Dynasty & Mystical Tea Highlands
shortDesc: Former capital of the Chand Kings. Home to Abbott Mount, Mayawati Advaita Ashrama visited by Swami Vivekananda, Devidhura, and holy Purnagiri shrine.

name: Udham Singh Nagar
tagline: The Terai Plains & Sacred Lake Sanctuaries
shortDesc: The fertile granary of Uttarakhand bordering the Kumaon foothills. Known for historic Gurudwara Nanakmatta Sahib, Nanak Sagar, and Giri Sarovar.

name: Chamoli
tagline: Abode of Badrinath, Valley of Flowers & Auli
shortDesc: The cradle of Himalayan spirituality and alpine wonders. Houses Shri Badrinath Dham, UNESCO Valley of Flowers, Hemkund Sahib, ski haven Auli, and Tungnath.
bestSeason: May to June & September to November (Skiing: Jan–Feb)

name: Rudraprayag
tagline: Gateway to Kedarnath Dham & Alaknanda-Mandakini Sangam
shortDesc: Named after Lord Shiva's Rudra avatar. Holy confluence of Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers, leading towards Kedarnath Dham, Madmaheshwar, and Chopta meadows.
bestSeason: May to June & September to November

name: Uttarkashi
tagline: The Northern Kashi & Sources of Ganga and Yamuna
shortDesc: The high mountaineering capital and home to both Gangotri and Yamunotri Dhams, picturesque Harsil valley apple orchards, and Dayara Bugyal meadows.
bestSeason: May to June & September to November

name: Tehri Garhwal
tagline: Emerald Tehri Lake & Serene Pine Ridges
shortDesc: Dominated by the massive emerald Tehri Dam lake with watersports, Surkanda Devi ridge, Dhanaulti eco-parks, and serene orchards of Kanatal.
bestSeason: March to June & September to December

name: Pauri Garhwal
shortDesc: Famous for the quiet colonial charm of Lansdowne, oak forests of Khirsu offering endless Himalayan skyline views, and Kandoliya temple.

name: Dehradun
shortDesc: The scenic Doon Valley capital featuring Forest Research Institute, Robber's Cave, Sahastradhara, leading up to the Queen of Hills Mussoorie and tranquil Landour.

name: Haridwar
tagline: Gateway to the Gods, Holy Ganga & Rishikesh
shortDesc: Where holy river Ganga descends into the Indo-Gangetic plains. The world spiritual hub featuring Har Ki Pauri Ganga Aarti, Mansa Devi, and the global yoga capital Rishikesh.
keyHighlights: Har Ki Pauri Evening Ganga Aarti
